cases.contract: Create selected basic layout once, admit matching canonical campaign and navigate to its editor; failures retain chooser and do not invent a document.
Load exact document; malformed, wrong-ID,403/404/503 receipts expose no editable stale design or action. Explicit successful retry restores current source.
PATCH exact current revision/name/config/design; preserve nested columns, unedited supported design/font/source-client fields. Never call generic workspace.document.update/snapshot.
Edit B while save of A is held; A receipt advances only matching document revision and does not erase B or mark B saved. Next explicit save carries latest B/revision.
409 save retains local input, shows conflict and blocks preview/stage/publication from claiming saved state; deliberate current reload/review needed. No automatic replacement save.
Lost save response remains unconfirmed; no automatic new save/stage. Current GET reconciliation is distinct from successful save receipt; retain input and require deliberate resolution.
Pending list/load/save/preview followed by document route, actor/session/org/client replacement or unmount cannot update former/new editor, navigate, or dispatch a later chained request.

Save-before-preview order uses latest acknowledged document; failed save sends zero preview calls. Held preview cannot render after source replacement. HTML iframe remains sandboxed without script/navigation privileges.

Canonical sanitization removes scripts/event handlers/javascript and unsafe CSS URLs before rich paste/preview; safe text/links and nested structure survive. Retain immutable packed116 renderer corpus.
Prevent moving a parent into its descendant; cross-section moves retain identity; cloned section/block IDs are distinct; Undo/Redo changes content without inventing server revision.

Response projection retains valid newsletterStageId and selecting a rich legacy record dispatches only rich GET/receiver. Ordinary records keep generic editor; malformed discrimination never falls through to generic write.

Valid newsletterStage uses rich POST/open and then rich record URL; newsletter uses GET only. Reject ambiguous/malformed params and wrong record/stage receipt. Never invoke saved-version V3 staging from a rich UUID.

Stage waits for latest saved revision; receipt documentId/revision/stageId/destination match requested authority. Repeat click sends one action. Same document/revision/owner recovery remains exact; never generate a substitute identity.
Preserve known sourceClientIds/template restrictions and canonical field values; changed/denied current client cannot gain access from a URL hint or template selection.
No hosted survey Add action; preserve supported historical display/removal if present, and report unsupported stage truthfully.

Existing saved-version strict body, source/hash/sponsor/session acknowledgement, exact request recovery, storage refusal, malformed receipt and actor replacement controls remain unchanged; prospect-origin Newsletter cannot open sending.

Desktop/phone keyboard entry, selection, dialog cancel/return focus, visible labels/errors and no horizontal clipping. Assert actual option focus between keyboard Select steps; preserve current shell/history boundaries.

Captured document/block/source URL receives upload/revision only if still current; selected block may change safely, changed original source/unmount rejects stale result. Reject empty/oversized file before dispatch; preserve alt/link and reset old crop only on accepted Insert/Done.

Manual alt edits beat late AI output; mismatched video result is ignored; old URL thumbnail is withheld; WebP video thumbnail rejected; capability unavailable sends zero provider/check calls; failed check no success or automatic retry.

Review role owner/editor edit-link only; reader/commenter no writer. Invitations/status use refusing fakes. Private prepared recipients/immutable versionIds, exclusions/held versions, exact test/send request keys and status-only recovery preserved; failed status read never submits again.

requirements: Meaningful failing baselines on current source for absent behavior.
Refuse/intercept every collaborator; review GET/account-status GET may be effectful.
Preserve original expectations, field/receipt equality and native call-count assertions.
No blanket UI/native acceptance from packed renderer tests.
